subject: Post-call: Beskar token profile + invoice sketch and next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@beskar.ai>
Cc: Ravi Desai <ravi@beskar.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Beskar token profile + invoice sketch and next steps

Hi Sam / Ravi —

Thanks for the productive call today. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we have a single place to track next steps. High-level notes: your product team is using LLM for real-time summarization and classification across customer transcripts; peak traffic is daytime PST; you plan a 6-week pilot then production rollout.

Open items for pricing/quote (can you confirm the cells below or drop the spreadsheet?):
- Typical inference mix: ~70% short completions (0–128 tokens) for classification, ~30% long summaries (average 800 tokens).
- Current baseline: ~2M tokens/day (avg) with weekly peaks up to 3.8M tokens.
- Expected growth during pilot: 4–6x baseline if pilot ramps as expected (looking at 8–12M tokens/day during peak by week 4).
- Budget target you mentioned on the call: $300–$450 per 1M tokens (target pricing band to hit internal ROI).

Deliverables from our side by EOD Monday:
- Draft invoice estimate for a 30-day pilot (spreadsheet + unit-rate scenarios).
- Two pricing bands: conservative (lower throughput, higher $/1M) and aggressive (higher throughput, lower $/1M with reserved capacity).
- SOW draft for the pilot with acceptance criteria and PO checklist.

Could you upload your token breakdown (by route / model) or confirm the figures above? If you prefer, attach your internal usage CSV and I’ll slot it into our calculator.

Attaching the unit-rate template we’ll use to build the invoice: redwood_unit_rate_calc.csv (empty template). If you want a quick call tomorrow to walk through the numbers, I’m free 10–11am PT.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood_unit_rate_calc.csv (template)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@beskar.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Desai <ravi@beskar.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Beskar token profile + invoice sketch and next steps

Stephanie —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the template. I uploaded our token export and a short notes sheet to the Drive folder (link below). Key numbers pulled from our telemetry:
- Average daily tokens (last 30 days): 2.1M
- 95th percentile daily tokens: 3.6M
- Expected pilot target: 35M tokens total in 30 days (~1.17M/day avg; expecting spikes to 6–8M on heavy days due to events).
- Model mix: 65% gpt-classic-13B-like, 35% long-summary variant (higher cost).
- Internal budget (procurement): initial pilot up to $18k–$22k (linked to pilot success metrics).

We attached a CSV: beskar_token_model.xlsx (token by route and expected ramp). Also looping in Procurement for PO timing.

Sam
Sam Turner
Head of Product
Beskar AI
--
Attachments: beskar_token_model.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-beskar-pilot

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Beskar token export + notes (internal analysis)

Folks — forwarding Sam's export with a quick pass on unit economics. I dropped numbers into the calc and sketched three invoice scenarios in redwood_unit_rate_calc.csv. Summary (rounded):

Scenario A — Pilot (conservative)- 30-day pilot modeled at 35M tokens total- Unit price assumed: $420 / 1M tokens- Estimated invoice: $14,700- Notes: no reserved capacity; uses hosted tiers; protects overhead for long-summary model mix

Scenario B — Pilot (reserved-lite)- Same volume (35M) but with a 20% reserved discount because they commit to min throughput during the pilot- Unit price: $360 / 1M tokens- Estimated invoice: $12,600- Notes: requires a short commitment / prepay for reserved slots; reduces tail risk on spikes

Scenario C — Ramp-target (volume play)- If they commit to a monthly run-rate of 900M tokens / month (production), we can offer $280 / 1M tokens (volume tier + quantization/optimizations)- This is a long-term commit quote — not for pilot

Attachments included: redwood_unit_rate_calc.csv (calc with inputs and per-route breakdown), pilot-sow-draft.pdf (SOW with acceptance criteria + metrics), and a simple 1-page slide embedded in the calc.

Recommended next steps for sales motion:
- Send Scenario A and B as formal invoice sketches to Sam + procurement. Highlight the difference in SLA/commitment.
- Ask procurement for PO lead time and whether prepay is acceptable.
- If they ask for mid-pilot reserved capacity, prepare a quick addendum for 20% reservation with proportional credit if they don’t hit thresholds.

I can turn Scenario B into a PO-ready invoice if Steph wants; need procurement contact details and billing address.

Rishi
Principal Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
--

Subject: Re: Post-call: Beskar token profile + invoice sketch and next steps

Thanks, Rishi — this is helpful and aligned with internal expectations. Ravi (cc) confirmed procurement can do a single PO for the pilot but needs the invoice sketch and SOW to include acceptance criteria and payment terms. I reviewed Scenarios A/B and the banding makes sense. Procurement prefers Scenario B pricing if we can include a 20% credit back or prorated refund if committed throughput isn’t met.

Next steps:
- Stephanie / Rishi: please send a formal invoice sketch for Scenario B plus the pilot SOW (we got the draft but need it embedded in the invoice packet).
- Procurement: will aim to turn a PO in 7–10 business days after receiving the packet.
- Schedule: Sam asked for pilot start during the week of Nov 2 (internal calendar window).

We attached a short procurement checklist to the Drive. Let us know if you want a quick 30-min sync with procurement this week.

Sam
